title: Atmometer
summary: ATMOM'ETER, noun [Gr. vapor, and to measure.] An instrument to measure the quantity of exhalation from a humid surface in a given time; an evaporometer.

inlines.v: ATMOM'ETER, noun [Gr. vapor, and to measure.] An instrument to measure the quantity of exhalation from a humid surface in a given time; an evaporometer.
